tasks.BloodBrainBarrierCellIdentification: Identify the type of cell that contributes to the blood-brain barrier by providing biochemical support to endothelial cells.

Questions.content: What specific biochemical support does this cell provide to endothelial cells in the context of the blood-brain barrier?
What is the specific name of this cell type, and how does it interact with endothelial cells to form the blood-brain barrier?
What is the specific role of this cell in maintaining the integrity and function of the blood-brain barrier beyond biochemical support?
